reasoning: This is a progress ring or radial completion gauge (specifically 5/8 full), which is UI chrome used in task managers to show how much of a task or project is done rather than what the task is about. Using it as a subject icon alongside checkboxes or progress circles is visually confusing, and true pie-chart tasks are better served by a dedicated chart icon with distinct separated slices.
